architecture: drift MLP and diffusion MLP, each Linear(2,32)-Softplus-Linear(32,32)-Softplus-Linear(32,1) on standardized (t, z) inputs; diffusion output Softplus + 0.01 floor. Smaller than the paper's width-64 nets (CPU cut); the paper additionally applies a final tanh to drift and diffusion, which is NOT used here because it would cap the drift range below the paper's own drift values at large t.
